correctness.rationale: Read the complete frozen RESULT.md and actual verify.py tree entry. Weyl equidistribution handles each fixed lag with O(k) truncation error; circle semicircle union gives L(k)=2-min_{ell-k odd}|k sqrt(5)-ell|. Consecutive (ell_j,q_j)=(2,1),(9,4),... are unimodular Pell vectors of the correct parity. Expanding any 0<k<q_(j+1) in this integral basis, the three sign cases force distance >=r^(j+1), equality only at (ell_j,q_j); the exact closed form of q_j then yields the plateau and endpoint liminf/limsup. Independent exact enumeration of 1799 finite-horizon lag minima confirmed the formula, without substituting for the infinite Diophantine proof. At finite lags irrationality strictly prevents perfect 2 coverage.
